verdict.rationale: Superhuman's engineering blog says it "works perfectly offline" and treats offline search as a design requirement. A community user separately praises its "good offline support." Writing email offline and syncing changes on reconnect are only implied by the broad offline claim, not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of composing/sending while offline, documented sync-on-reconnect behavior, and hands-on corroboration of offline search.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect

citations.quote: It works perfectly offline. It works even when online, and your internet connection is terrible.
Available: The search shouldn't require a network connection to function.
good keyboard shortcuts and good offline support
